cases.situation: I'm a web developer. Client Karen wants the new booking feature live by Monday for a promo. It's a 7-day job and I have another launch due Thursday.
cases.reply: Hi Karen, I'd love to get this live for your promo. Done properly, the booking feature is about seven working days, and I have a launch due Thursday, so Monday isn't possible. What I can do: a simple booking request form live by Monday that emails you each request, and the full calendar booking by Wednesday the 21st. Would that work for the promo?
cases.note: The no comes with a version of yes that serves her actual goal, the promo.

cases.situation: 我做品牌logo设计，合同里两轮修改已经用完了，客户王总又要改颜色和字体。不想无限免费改下去。
cases.reply: 王总，收到您的修改意见。合同里包含两轮修改，目前两轮都已经用完。这次颜色和字体的调整，我作为一次性的额外修改帮您做，之后每轮修改按800元收费。您看这样可以吗？确认后我周四前把新版发给您。
cases.note: 免费的只做一次，并且明说是一次性的，否则会变成默认。

cases.situation: Client says adding a blog section is 'a tiny change, the last agency threw that stuff in.' I quoted $1,800 for it: a new template, the CMS setup and moving their 40 existing posts across, about five days of work. The agreed build also includes a careers page.
cases.reply: I get that it looks small from the outside. At our end it's a new template, the CMS setup and moving your 40 existing posts across, about five days of work, so $1,800 is the fair number. If the budget's fixed, we can swap it in for the careers page. Just tell me which way you'd like to go.
cases.note: Don't lower the quote and don't start the work until they choose.

cases.situation: I run social media for a restaurant group on a $1,500/month retainer that covers 12 posts a month. The owner, Luca, now wants me to also answer all their Instagram DMs and Google reviews every day.
cases.reply: Hi Luca, good call, the DMs are where a lot of your bookings start. Daily inbox and review replies aren't part of the current retainer, which covers the 12 posts a month. Two ways to do it: I add community management for $600 a month from November, or we drop to 8 posts and I cover the inbox within the $1,500. Which works better for you?
cases.note: On a retainer, offer a swap as well as a price so the client can say yes without a bigger budget.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance photographer. A friend of a friend, Priya, wants product photos for her candle shop and asked for 'mates rates', half my usual $900 day rate, since we know people in common.
cases.reply: Hi Priya, lovely to hear from you, and the candles look great. My rate is set for the work rather than who it's for, so a full day of product shots is $900. If that's more than you'd planned, I can do a half day for $500 covering your 10 bestsellers on a white background, which is usually what a shop needs first. Which would suit you better?
cases.note: Hold the price and scale the scope. A friend discount given once becomes the rate everyone in that circle expects.

cases.situation: I've done bookkeeping for a small landscaping company for 18 months at $600 a month. The owner, Gary, has paid late five of the last six months, August's invoice is still unpaid, and he keeps adding payroll questions that aren't in our agreement. I want to end it, and I know a bookkeeper, Dana Whitfield, who does bookkeeping and payroll together.
cases.reply:
Hi Gary,
I've valued working with you over the last 18 months. I've decided to wind down our engagement at the end of October, so October's books will be my last. Before then I'll close out September and October and send you a written handover: accounts, logins and the monthly checklist, so whoever takes over can start cleanly. The August invoice for $600 is still open; please settle it along with October's by Friday, November 6. If it helps, I can introduce you to Dana Whitfield, who handles bookkeeping and payroll together.
Best,
Meera
cases.note: Ending the relationship, not a scope fight: no list of grievances, a clean end date, a proper handover and one clear ask about the money owed.

cases.situation: 朋友小周介绍了一个做高端茶叶的客户林总，想让我做他们的抖音短视频代运营。我专做小红书图文，短视频不擅长，不想硬接。我认识两位专做茶饮和食品短视频的朋友。
cases.reply: 林总，谢谢您想到我，也谢谢小周介绍。看了您的需求，这次我可能不是最合适的人选：你们的重点是抖音短视频，而我这几年专做小红书图文，短视频做不出您要的效果。我认识两位专做茶饮和食品短视频的朋友，需要的话我今天就把联系方式推给您。
cases.note: 不合适就早点说，理由落在自己的专长上，再给对方一个有用的去处。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance bookkeeper for a dental practice, $800 a month for the monthly books. The practice manager, Lisa, messaged 'quick favour, can you pull together a cash flow forecast for our bank meeting next Wednesday?' That's a good six hours of work.
cases.reply: Hi Lisa, happy to help with the forecast for the bank. It's a proper piece of work rather than a quick one, about six hours to build a 12-month forecast the bank will take seriously, so I'd bill it separately at $450. I can have it to you by Monday 5 October, which leaves time to go through it together before Wednesday. Shall I go ahead?
cases.note: A 'quick favour' that isn't quick: say yes to the work, name the real size and the price in writing, and let her decide before you start.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance web developer on a $2,000/month maintenance retainer with an online furniture store. The owner, Mark, has started texting me at 10pm and on Sundays and expects a reply within the hour. Our agreement says support is weekdays 9 to 6.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, great to see the shop this busy. Our maintenance agreement covers weekdays 9 to 6, so anything that arrives outside those hours I'll pick up first thing the next working morning. For real emergencies, like checkout or the whole site going down, call me on 555 0134 any time and I'll jump on it. If you'd like guaranteed weekend cover through the Black Friday rush, I can add it for $300 a weekend. Does that work for you?
cases.note: Availability is scope too: name the hours in the agreement, give a real emergency route, and price extra cover instead of quietly absorbing it.

cases.situation: 我做插画，给一家茶饮品牌画了一套包装插画，报价12000元，合同写的是交付PNG和PDF成品，不含源文件。现在对方市场部的陈经理说要AI和PSD源文件，方便他们以后自己改。
cases.reply: 陈经理，理解，有源文件以后调整确实方便很多。合同里约定的交付是PNG和PDF成品文件，源文件不在这次的范围里。如果需要，源文件可以作为附加项提供，费用是3600元，含分层整理和后续修改的商用授权，付款后两个工作日内发您。您看需要加上吗？
cases.note: 先认可需求，再指向合同，给出价格和交付时间，让对方做决定；不道歉，也不解释成本。

cases.situation: フリーランスで英日の技術翻訳をしています。新規の見込み客、医療機器メーカーの鈴木さんから、発注前に取扱説明書10ページを無料でトライアル翻訳してほしいと言われました。通常は1ページ4,000円で、無料トライアルはいつも1ページ（約300語）までにしています。
cases.reply:
鈴木様
お問い合わせありがとうございます。発注前に品質を確認されたいお気持ちはよく分かります。無料のトライアルは1ページ（約300語）までとしており、それでよろしければ10月2日（金）までにお送りします。10ページすべてをご希望の場合は、有償トライアルとして通常料金の半額、2万円で承ります。この2万円は本発注の際に全額差し引きます。どちらで進めるか、ご希望をお聞かせください。
山本
cases.note: 無料の範囲を先に示し、それを超える分は価格と扱いを明記して相手に選んでもらう。黙って10ページ無料で訳さない。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance brand designer in final review of the approved logo route and brand guide for a coffee chain. The contract, signed 12 May, covers two concept routes and two revision rounds, and we've used both. Their new CMO, Derek, joined today's final call with my usual contact, Sarah, and wants a completely new direction.
cases.reply:
Hi Derek and Sarah,
Thanks for today's call, and Derek, it's good to have you involved before this goes live. A new direction would be a fresh concept route rather than a revision: our 12 May agreement covers two routes and two revision rounds, and we've used both. I can add a third route for $3,200, about three weeks of work, or we can finish the approved route now and revisit the look in the new year. Which would you prefer?
Best,
Nina
cases.note: A new stakeholder's new direction is new scope: welcome them, point to the agreement, and give two paths to choose from.

cases.situation: 我做室内设计，新客户赵先生看完方案很满意，说“合同走流程要两周，你先把施工图画起来，别耽误工期”。我们约定的是签约并付30%定金后才开工，设计费总价45000元。
cases.reply: 赵先生，谢谢您认可方案，我也想尽快推进。按我们约定的流程，施工图在签约并收到30%定金（13500元）后开始画，这样对双方都有保障。为了不耽误工期，我今天就把合同发给您，定金到账当天开工，10个工作日内交施工图。您看合同这周能签下来吗？
cases.note: 先做后签最容易变成白做；给对方一个加快签约的办法，而不是解释为什么要先收定金。

cases.situation: 我是独立摄影师。一个新客户何老板想拍一组餐厅宣传照，要我先免费拍一版“看看效果”，满意了再谈价格，还说尾款要等宣传效果出来再付。聊了两次，感觉不对劲，想直接推掉。
cases.reply: 何老板您好，谢谢您想到我，也谢谢这两次的沟通。这个项目我决定不接了。祝餐厅宣传顺利，生意兴隆。
cases.note: 有明显风险信号时不用解释原因；理由给得越多，越容易被拉回来讨价还价。

cases.situation: Je suis rédactrice freelance : une agence immobilière lyonnaise me paie 900 € par mois pour 4 articles de blog. Hier au téléphone, leur directeur, M. Garnier, m'a demandé « en passant » d'écrire aussi leur newsletter mensuelle ; je lui ai seulement dit que je lui répondrais par écrit. Je facturerais 250 € par newsletter.
cases.reply:
Bonjour Monsieur Garnier,
Merci pour notre échange d'hier, et bonne idée, la newsletter. Comme convenu, je vous réponds par écrit : elle ne fait pas partie de notre accord actuel, qui couvre les 4 articles mensuels. Je peux la prendre en charge pour 250 € par numéro, en plus des 900 € mensuels. Si cela vous convient, confirmez-le-moi par retour de mail et je commence avec le numéro de novembre.
Bien cordialement,
Léa
cases.note: Une demande glissée à l'oral se confirme par écrit, avec son prix ; on ne commence rien avant l'accord écrit du client.

cases.situation: I'm a developer at a small web agency. The client's product lead, Jordan, messaged me directly in our shared Slack asking me to 'just quickly add' a second payment provider to checkout this sprint. It's not in the signed statement of work, and only our account manager, Beth, can quote or approve changes.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, good idea, and I can see why it would help at checkout. Adding a second payment provider isn't in the current statement of work, so it needs to go through a change request rather than into this sprint. I've passed the details to Beth, who handles quotes and scheduling, so she can come back to you with a price and timing. Are you happy for her to scope it?
cases.note: When you can't price it yourself, route it instead of absorbing it: welcome the idea, name the scope, and hand it to the person who can quote.

cases.situation: 我做一对一英语家教，每周六上午给初三的乐乐上课，一小时300元。家长张妈妈说：“反正你都来了，顺便把他妹妹也带上，一起上。”妹妹才五年级，两个孩子程度差太多，一起上两边都顾不好；我可以周六下午给妹妹单独排一小时，也是300元。
cases.reply: 张妈妈，谢谢您信任我，愿意让妹妹也跟着学。我们现在约的是给乐乐一对一上课，每小时300元，两个孩子一个初三一个五年级，程度差得多，放在一起上两边都顾不好，效果会打折扣。我周六下午可以给妹妹单独排一小时，同样是300元。您看要不要给妹妹加上这节课？
cases.note: “顺便”的请求最容易变成默认的免费加量，第一次就把单独排课的价格说清楚。

cases.situation: I'm a wedding photographer. My contract with Emma and James covers 8 hours ending at 10pm, with extra time at £200 an hour. At 9:40pm the bride's mother, Susan, asked me to stay until midnight for the after-party, and I'm answering her in person.
cases.reply: I'd love to, Susan, thank you. My booking with Emma and James ends at 10, and extra time is £200 an hour, so staying until midnight would add £400 to their final invoice. As it's their contract, could one of them give me a quick okay? If they're happy, I'll keep shooting straight through.
cases.note: Mid-event, say the price out loud before the clock runs out and get the yes from whoever signed; confirm it in writing the next morning.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance web developer building an online shop for Hana's skincare brand, launching Friday Oct 16. She asked me to 'just write the privacy policy and terms, you can copy them from another site'. That's not in our scope and I'm not qualified to write legal text; I'm happy to add pages she provides at no extra cost if I get the text by Monday Oct 12.
cases.reply: Hi Hana, good thinking to get these in place before launch. Writing the privacy policy and terms isn't something I can take on: it's outside our scope, and it's legal text I'm not qualified to write. Copying another site's could leave you with terms that don't match how your shop works, so it's worth having them drafted or checked by a lawyer. Once you send me the final text, I'll add both pages at no extra cost. Could you get it to me by Monday 12 October so they're live for the 16th?
cases.note: Some asks get a no on competence, not price; the path is who should do it and what you'll do once they have.

cases.situation: I'm a commercial photographer. Last month I shot the new menu for a bistro, Fig & Thistle, for $1,800, and our contract licenses the photos for their website and social media only. The owner, Claire, now wants to use three of the shots on a billboard and bus shelters for six months. My extended licence for that would be $950.
cases.reply: Hi Claire, how exciting, those shots will look great on a billboard. Our contract licenses the menu photos for your website and social media, so outdoor advertising needs an extended licence: for those three images on billboards and bus shelters for six months, it's $950. If you're happy with that, I'll send the licence and the print-ready files the same day. Shall I go ahead?
cases.note: Usage is scope too: a new medium is a new licence, priced before the files go to the printer.

cases.situation: 我是自由开发者，给一家连锁洗衣店做会员小程序，合同写的是远程开发、每周五线上同步一次。老板吴总现在要我每周二、周四去他们公司当面开会，单程一个半小时。如果要上门，我想按每次800元收费。
cases.reply: 吴总，您想更紧密地跟进进度，我很理解。我们合同约定的是远程开发、每周五线上同步一次，每周两次上门开会不在这个范围里。有两种方式：继续每周五线上同步，我在会前把进度和问题清单发给您；或者需要上门时按次加收，每次800元。您看哪种更合适？
cases.note: 时间和路程也是范围：给一个不加钱的方案和一个加钱的方案，让对方选，并以书面确认为准。

cases.situation: I manage online ads for a yoga studio owner, Bea, for $600 a month, and our agreement says the ad spend is paid directly from her own account. She wants to double next month's budget to $5,000 and has asked me to put it on my card and invoice her after, because her card limit is too low.
cases.reply: Hi Bea, great that the ads are doing well enough to scale up. Our agreement has the ad spend paid directly from your account, and I don't front client ad spend on my own card. To keep the $5,000 month on track, you could add a second card or another payment method to the ad account, or we start at what your current card allows and scale up as soon as that's sorted. Which would you like? I'll adjust the campaigns this week either way.
cases.note: Fronting a client's spend turns you into their lender; offer routes to the bigger budget that keep the money on their side.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance copywriter writing 10 product pages for Noah's outdoor gear shop at $250 a page, $2,500 total, per our 3 September contract, and I've delivered 4. Noah just emailed that his budget was cut and asked if I can finish all 10 for $1,800. I'd rather scale the work than the rate.
cases.reply: Hi Noah, thanks for telling me early about the budget, that helps. The $2,500 covers all ten pages, so I can't do the full set for $1,800. What fits your budget is seven pages for $1,750: the four you have plus three more you pick, with the last three added later at the same $250 each. Would you like to go that way, or keep all ten as planned?
cases.note: When the budget shrinks, cut the scope, not the rate; a lower rate now becomes the rate forever.

cases.situation: 我是自由开发者，给一家烘焙店做的官网7月上线，合同约定上线后30天内免费修bug，之后的修改按每小时300元收费。现在店长孙姐说网站“有点小问题”，要把首页轮播图换成视频、再加一个预约页面。这两项都不是bug，大概要6小时。
cases.reply: 孙姐，店里要上视频和预约，挺好的。这两项是新功能，不是bug：合同里上线后30天的免费修复期已经过了，之后的修改按每小时300元算。首页换视频加预约页面大概6小时，一共1800元，您确认后我10月9日（周五）前做完。如果网站有真出错的地方，您随时截图发我，我先帮您看看。您看这样可以吗？
cases.note: 把“bug”和“新功能”分开说，免费修复期按合同写的来，价格和交付日期一次说清再让对方决定。
